mentions.name: profiler-md
mentions.description: A CLI that converts performance profiles into Markdown that is friendly for both humans and LLMs. It is gaining a diffing feature to compare before vs after profiles and ships with a skill that lets a coding agent profile and optimize code.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a CLI that converts performance profiles to human and LLM friendly Markdown:

https://github.com/TomerAberbach/profiler-md

Currently working on a diffing feature to compare before vs after profiles.

It also comes with a skill to have a coding agent profile and optimize your code!
